display_name: LoRa W24 等能量宽带与有色源噪声对照（Full）
description: Test whether continuous bandwidth-colored additive source noise improves Full W24 recovery at matched packet power, weights and fit budget.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms load only exact frozen original-loss 24,000-step U-Net model tensors, no optimizer, no inherited metrics or selection. Reset AdamW for 12,000 source-only steps.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Previously frozen source comparator only in independent evaluation. No fitting or freezing access.
Verified original-loss U-Net source-only model weights, terminal 24000 steps, both arms. Also fixed frozen source comparison.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same registered source IQ partition, verified original data and training proof, matching checkpoint binding and fixed terminal source selection. E104 only after both new weights are frozen.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Unlabeled U_s, original archive and source protocol match. Verified zero F/TX/V/target reads during parent fit. No target result used in inheritance.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze step 12000 (36000 model updates including parent). Candidate half strictly beats six-scene fixed controls, matches strongest low urban and direct clean. Eligible run auto-starts three Full blind shards and independent target scoring follows the complete frozen matrix.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 candidate order 2, 3, 0, each with at least 12 GiB free, at most one incumbent Python job per admitted card, one arm per GPU. Per-card visible CUDA context guard under eight.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on a systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure. Preserve all artifacts. Source scores gate only target eligibility via preregistered paired rules.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --noise-color after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.method: Energy-matched additive leg using native wideband complex white noise
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 new updates starting from the same 24000-step original source U-Net model state. Batch 16, AdamW restart with same cosine schedule.

rows.method: Energy-matched additive leg using continuously bandlimited complex noise
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 new updates starting from the same 24000-step original source U-Net model state. Batch 16, AdamW restart with same cosine schedule.

notes: Both arms draw the same two archived mixed perturbations and all random streams. In 65% of views, replace the perturbation by additive noise with identical W24 center power. In 35%, retain the original mixed IQ exactly.

Control uses native IID noise. Candidate uses a smooth bandpass magnitude with uniform half bandwidth 0.045 to 0.250 times capture rate and center shift -0.07 to +0.07 times rate. Parameters are generic source-only continuous draws, independent of practical profile settings and target observations.
Both arms use the same colored held validation at 2000, 6000, 9000 and final 12000; all waveform losses, source packet choices, ancestry, and frozen W24 evaluation are matched.
